title: Hayati Pro Max Mr Blue Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Hayati Pro Max Mr Blue is a dark berry medley of Blackberry, Blueberry and Raspberry, finished with a brisk Menthol chill. The Blackberry and Blueberry bring smooth, juicy depth, while Raspberry adds a subtle tang. The Menthol layer ties it all together with a clean, cooling lift that enhances rather than overpowers the fruit. Blended with nicotine salts for quicker satisfaction and a smoother throat hit, this e-liquid is ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) devices such as pod kits and starter systems. The 50VG/50PG ratio ensures consistent vapour and flavour clarity throughout the day. This flavour is part of the Hayati Pro Max Nic Salt range, inspired by Hayati’s own bestselling disposable vapes and now reimagined in a longer-lasting 10ml format—available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths.
